speech.text: 10 Weird Things You Didn't Know About Lil Baby First off, Lil Baby used to hang out with guys almost twice his age when he was only 10 years old, so they started calling him Lil Baby. He also loved sleeping so much that he would randomly fall asleep anywhere, even while hanging out with his friends. Next he had a habit of leaving trash everywhere like a little kid instead of cleaning up after himself. Even weirder, Lil Baby absolutely hated packing suitcases whenever he traveled. He would simply buy new outfits every time he arrived in another city instead of bringing clothes. Even crazier, a journalist once had to ride a jet ski for about 10 minutes just to reach Lil Baby for an interview out in the middle of the water. During one of Lil Baby's music video shoots in Atlanta, a shooting broke out nearby, leaving three people injured. Before becoming famous, Lil Baby spent nearly two years in prison, where he claimed to have read around 200 books. But later he couldn't remember many of their titles. Even crazier, after Lil Baby got out of prison, young Thug found him back in the streets and encouraged him to become a rapper. But Lil Baby wasn't interested because he was already making money hustling. So young Thug offered him $10 ,000 just to go to the recording studio. Lil Baby eventually agreed and became one of the biggest rappers in America.
